query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('users',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'username',username)),'[]') FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL),'groups',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name)),'[]') FROM groups),'photos',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'album_id',album_id,'title',title)),'[]') FROM photos WHERE deleted_at IS NULL),'places',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',name)),'[]') FROM places)) AS "choices!"
